lines.reference: Potatoes, flesh and skin, raw — USDA FDC 170026: 77 kcal / 100 g
Egg, whole, raw, fresh — USDA FDC 171287 (SA large egg 55 g out of shell): 143 kcal / 100 g
Vinegar, distilled — USDA FDC 172237 (SA brown/white spirit vinegar): 18 kcal / 100 g
SA mayonnaise (Crosse & Blackwell Tangy, FatSecret ZA): 2088 kJ, 52 g fat, 9 g carbohydrate, 0.1 g protein / 100 g (used 499 kcal / 100 g)
Mustard, prepared, yellow — USDA FDC 172234: 60 kcal / 100 g
Sugars, granulated — USDA FDC 169655: 387 kcal / 100 g

No energy (salt; pepper to taste is negligible)

notes: Assumptions that change the number: 1 cup SA tangy-style mayonnaise ≈ 240 g at 499 kcal / 100 g (the mayonnaise is ~48 % of the energy); potatoes peeled at the USDA raw value; cooking-water salt not counted. Sanity check: USDA potato salad, home-prepared (FDC 169269) is 143 kcal / 100 g and ours is ~140 kcal / 100 g (2486 kcal over ~1.78 kg). Per serving we are higher than Spinneys' aartappelslaai (299 kcal, serves 4) and FatSecret's 262 kcal a cup, because one sixth of this bowl is a generous ~295 g side.
